state.user_request: 整体是非常好的典型案例，但奇怪的上色纹理和不自然高光是致命缺陷；需对齐官方和r1，建立反模式，注意CI，从像素根源避免缺陷，尽可能脱离绘图模型并做受监控端到端测试。DeepSeek典型参考就是r1。
observed: Existing imagegen diagnostic PNG has user-approved overall composition, not approved paint. User marked both angular isolated light patches and subtle mottling.
Prior global palette tracing caused cheek loss, hard color bands and cross-family colors. New annotated PNG and the old diagnostic have equal alpha and only tiny RGB recompression differences.
Fixed positive-reference calibrated texture thresholds do not reliably separate the subtle human-marked mottling; highlight naturalness is not a valid single image score.

Repository has no CI. Current skill drawing core uses stdlib; isolated validation can use pinned resvg/Pillow/numpy/scipy. No live drawing model or external key is needed to compile geometry plus paint and render checks.
state.scope: Implementation decisions delegated to agent; do not infer aesthetic approval or ask the user to reselect an already explicit reference.

paint_backend.instructions: Which implementation approach best addresses the user's recurring unwanted texture/highlight defects while preserving accepted geometry and reducing dependence on drawing models?

criteria.analytic_plan: Keep curated geometry immutable; compile material colors, bounded smooth gradients and ownership-constrained shadows from a declarative plan. More upfront explicit geometry/paint work, reproducible painting without live drawing model.
criteria.model_regenerate: Regenerate the entire raster with more negative prompt instructions and then convert to SVG. Less geometric authoring, but stochastic texture recurrence and preserved identity are uncertain.
criteria.global_quantization: Increase palette size or filtering on prior raster-to-vector tracing. Fast conversion, but known banding/noise and semantic grouping failures remain.

ci_gate.instructions: Which CI evidence design honestly prevents detectable defects without disguising artistic uncertainty as a green metric?

criteria.layered_evidence: Gate static paint contract, deterministic rerender, alpha/interior texture negative controls and local-change invariants; retain highlight/identity visual review as explicit non-automated status. More evidence artifacts, calibrated scope.
criteria.single_pixel_score: Use one similarity/noise threshold for all pictures and call low score visually accepted. Simpler automation but conflates identities, valid gradients and semantic quality.
criteria.llm_judge_only: Use a live vision model to judge every CI output. Flexible interpretation but external credentials, nondeterminism and no mechanical invariant guarantee.
